items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: I was housegirl and maid for Miss Nina King... I know Miss Annie died... Grace King, Grace Elizabeth King.

ctx.x: When did you learn German? You said you learned German and Spanish too, didn't you?
Well, that was from Mrs. W. W. King, you know, yes. Grace King's folks? Grace King, Grace Elizabeth King.
Where did she live when you worked for her?
